name: phd-nd-mscse-course-retaken-counts-once
description: Credit-transfer review 2026-10-28 (#5): CSE 60111 passed with a C in the student’s own Notre Dame MSCSE and taken again in the Ph.D. The retake rule looked only at rows filed as this program’s, so both counted — 6 credits from one 3-credit course, toward the 60, the 24 and the nine at Notre Dame — with no warning. Notre Dame’s catalogue is one wherever a row is filed: the later attempt counts, the MSCSE one reads superseded, and “CSE 60111 is entered 2 times — its credits count once.”
expectWarnings: CSE 60111 is entered 2 times — its credits count once.
